title: DOCSIS 4.0 MMM preparation
description:
This is part of an effort to introduce new DOCSIS 4.0 MAC Management Messages and fields in Wireshark,
based on [CM-SP-MULPIv4.0-I08-231211](https://www.cablelabs.com/specifications/CM-SP-MULPIv4.0).

- Special Use MAC Header is new, and for now only used for RBA-HW (Table 6, 6.2.3, 6.4.51)
- MMM v5 MultiPart handling is not new, but will be used by more packets than before (6.4.1).
